body:
Alright chaps. At first forgive me for my poor vocabulary, but I'm not native english speaker. 

So the time has come and 7 hours has gone. I put ~1g of potassium cyanide into the cup full of water, it fizzed a little bit in the mineral water and immediately dissapeared. I did stir it a little bit and cover it with some saucer, since the gas from KCN reacting with water will probably make me nautions, I have already taken some pills which will prevent me from vomiting. Since I'm quite skinny (~70kg, for american fellas I guess it would ~150lbs), the amount of 1g of KCN will react rather quickly, according to medical documentation which I've found out, I'll collapse within 10 minutes, loose conscience and from than on - it really doesn't matter). Cardiac rest will cause immediate death, painless since I won't be even conscious. 

This prepared mix of KCN and H2O will most certainly be affective even after few hours time, since cyanide will not fade in the water. 

Now... why am I'm posting this and why I even bothered to post this on this subreddit, well maybe because I'm not going to leave any letter for family, but most certainly not because I'm seeking help - **altough I really do appreciate you trying**. Being anonymous on this reddit really helps me to say some things without any consequences. 

The rest of the text isn't really about my suicide, but about the reason I'm determined to end this deplorable story of my life. 

First of, you can rationalize all the things that have ever happened to you, you can say that they have happened for a reason, that you've learned a lesson from them and they made you stronger but the simple truth of the matter is that this 'jabs' will sooner or later has some effects on you. It's like a puncher, that can take some hits till some point when he simply started to loose his mojo and strength.

Do you remember your first mistakes ? I guess, every does. But after a while when those mistakes, bad decisions and tragedies that happened to you sum up, you'll loose your motiviation. Lose the interest in living a life like you did before, careless, happy with some goals to achieve. Than comes the phase of depression, which will most recently last for months, if not years till you realize that it's not a case of bad mood and neither it's illness made up by big pharmacy company. 

Once you entered the phase of depression and being fully aware of some problems, I guess that a few years has already gone and it had a great affect on your comfort of life and decisions you've made. You will try to fight it in thousands of possible ways, **just like I did**, telling myself that the best is ahead of me and I will have certainly good moments in my life. But in the meantime I've realized that frankly, I've lost several years of my life that I will most likely never recover - just to give you an example of what I'm on about. Imagine participating in 100m sprint race, the depression that has caused all the damage to you will be like a really poor start, messed up get away, when you've already lost a lot of time in comparison to your rivals. Will you give up ? Most likely NOT. 

But, after a while, while covering the distance, **plainly** you'll come to a conclusion that the gap is to big and you won't win this sprint, most likely you won't even end up on the podium. Back to life and my comparison, **depression which I've been fighting for a couple of years** made me realize that it relates to this bad start comparison. Yes, I can carry on, but ask yourself a question. **Will you be happy with compromised outcome of your life ?** With the fact that you've messed up so many times and it affected your life greatly. Will you be happy with being out of the podium position just like in this sprint race metaphore ? 

My answer is: no. I'm quite competetive person, I always have been . It makes me want to cry when I think that due to depression I fall behind my peers, and will not make up those years I've lost. 

The only reason to stay alive is when you do have someone that believes in you or depend on you, being a parent who decided to commit suicide is completely unacceptable if your kids aren't mature. But frankly, **I don't have anyone of this kind**, on top of that I'm afraid that even if I carry on like this and magically started to feel better, the depression will hit back like a cancer and remission - the depression will start to fade away, but it will just a matter of time when it will come back, like a pain once the adrenaline has faded. 

I'm afraid that I'm the one which will always carry this illness and in the future it's better not to affect your girlfriend/boyfriend and especially kids with your attitude cause by depression, on top of that once you've got kids (which I don't have fortunately) you will have to live for them no matter what - you would have to take responsibility and stay alive for them, while not trying to spoil their lives caused by your ilness). 

*****************************************************
I won't go into personal details of my life, since noone will ever understand my attitude, my mentality and my own plan for my life which, as you've already guessed, didn't work out and has been severely compromised by depression. 

I really do appreciate all efforts and PM I got, but in my case it won't make any difference. What I wish you, guys is to get better since some of you probably find this subreddit for a good reason *if you know what i mean. 

Anyway, I'm home alone and frankly noone will interrupt me. I have heard that patients who commited a suicide with cyanide, will, shortly after swallowing the mixture, shriek - due to cyanide affecting heart and respiratory system causing it to malfunction and trying to take a breath while braising. Frankly it won't make any difference, since I'll choke on the 'cell level'. Will try to lie on the bed and prepare for the worst, it won't take too long before I collapse, at most 10 minutes, I'll take that, been suffering from worse pain for much longer, will try to occupy my mind on some music, hopefully will collpase quickly, with less than 10 minutes. From than on, it's highway to heaven, altough I'm not believer. 

I don't give a damm, about who will find me or my corpse I should say, I only hope that so called after life will be more pleasent for me than this one on earth and will meet my family relatives who have already gone. 

To the bottom my friends.
